hints.title: Prototype Chain Iterative Verification
hints.text: Determining whether an item is an instance of a constructor requires checking its prototype inheritance link recursively until finding a match or reaching the end of the chain.

hints.title: Traversing the Prototype Linkage
hints.text: Validate that the target constructor is a valid callable function. Use Object.getPrototypeOf repeatedly on the object, comparing against the constructor prototype property.

hints.title: Step-by-Step Prototype Loop Blueprint
hints.text: If obj is null or undefined or classFunction is not function, return false. Let curr = Object(obj). While curr is not null: if Object.getPrototypeOf(curr) === classFunction.prototype return true; curr = Object.getPrototypeOf(curr). Return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Traverses prototype links linearly in constant extra memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: The native instanceof operator returns false for primitive values like numbers or strings even when checking against Number or String.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Object(obj) wrapping normalizes primitives into prototype-bearing instances without memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of primitive values and defensive checks against null or non-function constructors.

solutions.approach: Iterative Prototype Chain Walking with Primitive Boxing
